title: Juniper and the Ember
author: F. M. Thackeray
blurb: Paloma Coldharbour, a debt-bound temple scribe, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
